title: Love Language #3: Receiving Gifts
coreMove: Receiving Gifts speaks through visible symbols of thought: small, chosen tokens and crisis presence tell a spouse they were remembered, not priced, when it counts.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A saver may call every gift waste and miss the spouse's love language.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Reframe an affordable gift as relationship investment.

exampleSpecs.audience: Hadley, a spouse carrying two absences
exampleSpecs.stakes: A later object cannot replace presence during vulnerability and grief.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Name presence as the missing gift.

exampleSpecs.audience: Florent, a teacher answering a skeptical objection
exampleSpecs.stakes: A class may reduce gifts to consumer habit and miss their symbolic role.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use cultural patterns to answer the materialism objection.

exampleSpecs.audience: Zachary, a spouse practicing inexpensive gifts
exampleSpecs.stakes: A found object might be dismissed before its thought can speak.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show that a found or handmade token can carry attention.

exampleSpecs.audience: Albertine, a spouse hurt by a forgotten date
exampleSpecs.stakes: A missed occasion can signal that the person was not remembered.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Repair a missed symbolic moment without mocking the need.

exampleSpecs.audience: Antonio, a spouse interrupted before a client call
exampleSpecs.stakes: A polished explanation may cost more than the meeting is worth.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Treat embodied presence as the gift during fear.
